title: SGLT2 INHIBITION FOR CARDIOVASCULAR ENDPOINT REDUCTION IN HYPERTENSION
official: SGLT2 INHIBITION FOR CARDIOVASCULAR ENDPOINT REDUCTION IN HYPERTENSION
summary: Main objective: To assess whether the addition of a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitor (SGLT2i) to standard antihypertensive treatment confers a reduction in major adverse cardiovascular and renal events.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥60 years
2. Systolic blood pressure ≥140 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure ≥ 90 mmHg in two measurements on different days for newly diagnosed hypertension, or through one measurement at the screening visit for patients with an existing diagnosis of hypertension.
3. A history of at least one CV event (myocardial infarction* or stroke*; stable angina or clinical evidence of coronary heart disease; peripheral arterial disease; transient ischemic attack) (*excluding patients with myocardial infarction or stroke within preceding 3 months)
4. or  The presence of at least one cardiovascular risk factor (current smoking of more than one cigarette per day during at least 1 year; LDL-cholesterol ≥ 4,0 mmol/l, Age ≥ 75 years, ESC HeartScore ≥ 15%, BMI ≥ 32 kg/m2, eGFR ≤60 mL/min/1.73m2 (estimated by CKD-EPICr 2021 formula)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known secondary cause of hypertension
2. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to SGLT2i
3. Women who are pregnant, nursing, or who plan to become pregnant while in the trial
4. Any medical condition - outside the renal and CV disease area - with a life expectancy of less than 2 years based on investigator’s clinical judgement
5. Active malignancy requiring treatment at the time of visit 1 (with the exception of successfully treated basal cell or treated squamous cell carcinoma)
6. Inability to give informed consent
7. Myocardial infarction or stroke within the previous 3 months
8. Symptomatic heart failure (including HFrEF, HFmEF, HFpEF)
9. History of Diabetes mellitus
10. History of ketoacidosis
11. Hepatic impairment (aspartate transaminase [AST] or alanine transaminase [ALT] ≥3x the upper limit of normal [ULN])
12. eGFR ≤25 mL/min/1.73 m2 (CKD-EPICr 2021 formula) at Visit 1
13. Receiving therapy with an SGLT2i within 8 weeks prior to randomization or previous intolerance to an SGLT2i
14. Participation in another clinical study with an investigational product during the last month prior to enrolment
